summary.name: LibreWolf
summary.one_liner: LibreWolf is a custom, independent version of Firefox focused on privacy, security and user freedom.
use_cases: browsing without telemetry or data collection
using a Firefox-based browser with built-in ad blocking
contributing to an open-source browser project
summary.what_it_does:
LibreWolf is a custom build of Firefox that applies privacy- and security-oriented settings and patches. It aims to increase protection against tracking and fingerprinting and includes some security improvements. The project says it removes telemetry, data collection and other annoyances, and disables DRM. It ships with uBlock Origin included and offers privacy-conscious search providers such as DuckDuckGo and Searx. The project states it is always built from the latest Firefox stable source.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">open source
notable: Firefox fork with privacy and security hardening and telemetry removed
Built from the latest Firefox stable source
Community-driven project with Matrix, Reddit and Lemmy presence
caveats: Platforms supported are not listed on the page; it mentions contributing builds for unsupported operating systems
Based on Firefox, so it inherits upstream Firefox behavior and updates as its base
